dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I know that one. Vodyanitsa's the lead...

dialogues.speaker: Osipova
dialogues.text: That is correct. Have you already seen her in "Death of the Ice Lake" too? I must admit, I am here for Miss Vodyanitsa.

dialogues.speaker: Osipova
dialogues.text: Tell me you haven't forgotten her second aria in the third act! The way she performed her vibrato, the way her voice quivered with such divine, tragic weight... It was like a celestial being had come down from heaven to inhabit her very soul!

dialogues.speaker: Osipova
dialogues.text: If you're interested, she's holding a solo recital next Wednesday evening. As it happens, I have an extra ticke——

dialogues.speaker: Osipova
dialogues.text: Ahem. Please don't get me wrong. I'm only doing this so that more people can learn what a wonderful singer she is.
